title: Engraved line from a circle
description: A circle with a 14.5 x 14.0 mm outline (16.5 x 16 mm with its 2 mm line) converted to an engraved line: a needle point wherever a fill stitch crosses the line. PE-DESIGN 11.50 adds 118 needle points on the circle's outline (whatever the width of the circle's own line, #956); OpenStitch adds 120 there.

evidence.note: PE-DESIGN 11.50 round-10 capture 471-engraved-line-circle.pes (SHA-256 ce29d0ecf546293e3356c3d9b69100bdad98e9253382cf3f956a44edaafc6197, 3369 stitches), measured for #471; the reference file since #959

references.make: On a 180 x 130 mm Design Page draw a square with Home > Shapes > Rectangle, 42.00 x 42.00 mm with its line (a 40 mm outline from 30 to 70 mm), PE-DESIGN's defaults kept: line Zigzag Stitch 2.0 mm, 4.5 line/mm, Half Stitch on; region Fill Stitch 4.5 line/mm, 45 degrees, under sewing on. Draw a circle in its middle with Home > Shapes > circle, 16.50 x 16.00 mm with its 2 mm zigzag line (a 14.5 x 14.0 mm outline), defaults kept. Select both (Ctrl+A) and choose Home > Stamp/Emboss > Convert from Outline > Engraved Line: the circle becomes a stamp in the square's fill. Save As 'Layout & Editing Ver 11.0 File (*.PES)'. Status bar 3369 st.

measurements.evidence: 3,296 stitches: 120 more than the plain square, on a ring at 7.06 mm (PE-DESIGN 118 more, at 7.12 mm: on the circle's outline whatever its line's width, #956), on the 40 mm square with the 14.5 mm circle
